elements.name: km-editor
elements.description:
---


### **Events:**
 - **change** - The document changed. `detail.value` is the content serialized in the active `format`; `detail.format` is that format.
- **ready** - The engine was built and mounted (once per element lifetime). No detail beyond readiness.
- **mode-change** - The `mode` attribute/property changed. `detail.mode` is the new mode.

### **Methods:**
 



- **getValue(format: _EditorFormat_): _string_** - Live content serialized in the active `format` (or an explicit one).
- **getContent(format: _EditorFormat_): _string_** - Alias for getValue — reads live content, not the assigned `value` input.
- **setValue(value: _string_, format: _EditorFormat_): _void_** - Replace the document with `value`, parsed in `format` (defaults to the active one).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial content to load, interpreted per `format`. Reassigning replaces the document. Reading `el.value` returns this assigned value, NOT live edits — use `getValue()` for that.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Serialization lens for content I/O (`value`, `getValue()`, the `change` event): 'markdown' (default), 'html', or 'json'. Switching it re-reports the SAME document in the new format — it never rebuilds the document.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Presentation: 'edit' (default), 'split' (editor + live output), 'preview' (read-only render), or 'inline' (overlay chrome on a live-page element). `preview` forces read-only. Full layouts arrive in Phase 3; for now the mode is stored, reflected, and announced via `mode-change`.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Make the editor read-only (no input). `mode="preview"` also forces this on.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.description: Static toolbar edge: 'top' (default), 'bottom', 'start', or 'end' places the command toolbar flush against that side of the editor; 'none' hides it. The selection toolbar and context menu are always available while editing (independent of this).

attributes.name: statusbar
attributes.description: Status bar edge: 'none' (default), 'top', 'bottom', or 'both'. A dedicated strip of live indicators (word/char count, plus any plugin status items), hugging the editor body — separate from the toolbar zones and shown in read-only too. With 'both', items split across the two strips by their `bar` ('top'/'bottom', default 'bottom').

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Theme name, reflected to the host attribute for CSS theming (`:host([theme="…"])`).

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: For `mode="inline"` only: a CSS selector for the live-page element the floating editor card anchors to (tracked via the core positioning primitive). Absent → the inline card renders in normal flow.

properties.name: plugins
properties.description:
The editor plugin set. Assign to customise — compose with `defaultPlugins()`
to keep the built-ins, and order the array to control conflict precedence
(later plugins override earlier by id). Reassigning rebuilds the engine on the
new set, preserving the live content. Reading returns the active set.

```js
import { defaultPlugins } from '@keenmate/web-editor';
el.plugins = [...defaultPlugins(), myPlugin];
```

properties.name: engine
properties.description: The underlying headless engine (null before the first build / after teardown).

properties.name: isReady
properties.description: Whether the engine has been built and `ready` has fired.
